app.name: Club Manager
app.tagline: Run your esports organization: people, roles, teams and games in one place.

auth.signInLead: Use the email and password you joined with.
auth.discordHint: Discord works once you have linked it from Settings.
auth.registerLead: You will be its first Owner. Everyone else joins by invitation.
auth.organizationSlugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Used in links.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
auth.forgotLead: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we will send a reset link that works for 60 minutes.
auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.resetLead: This signs you out everywhere else.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth.resetMissingToken: This page needs the link from your reset email.
auth.signupDisabled: New organizations can't be created here right now. Ask an Owner to invite you.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.existingAccount: You already have an account with this email. Sign in, then come back to this link to join.
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in with a different email. Sign out and use {email}.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.not_found: That item doesn't exist or isn't available to you.
errors.conflict: That name is already in use.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.account_suspended: Your access has been suspended. Contact an Owner of your organization.
errors.no_active_organization: You're not in an active organization.
errors.origin_not_allowed: This request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page.
errors.signup_disabled: New organizations can't be created here right now.
errors.slug_taken: That organization address is taken. Try another.
errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.invalid_or_expired_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.login_required: An account with this email exists. Sign in to accept.
errors.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member.
errors.last_owner: The organization needs at least one active Owner.
errors.cannot_target_self: You can't do that to your own account.
errors.owner_only_permission: Some of these permissions are reserved for Owners.
errors.system_role_locked: The Owner role can't be changed.
errors.role_in_use: This role is still assigned or used by a pending invitation.
errors.invalid_scope: That role or scope isn't available in this organization.
errors.department_not_empty: Move or delete this department's teams first.
errors.game_in_use: Teams use this game. Deactivate it instead.
errors.discord_not_configured: Discord sign-in isn't set up for this platform yet.
errors.discord_not_linked: That Discord account isn't linked to anyone here. Sign in with email, then link Discord in Settings.
errors.discord_already_linked: That Discord account is already linked to another user, or you already linked one.
errors.oauth_state_invalid: The Discord sign-in expired or was interrupted. Try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.

overview.ownerAccess: You are an Owner of this organization: you can see and change everything.
overview.noAccess: You don't have any permissions yet. An Owner can assign you a role.
overview.teamsVisible: {count, plural, =0 {No teams} one {# team} other {# teams}} visible to you
overview.pendingInvites: {count, plural, =0 {No pending invitations} one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
overview.noOrganization: You're not part of an active organization
overview.noOrganizationLead: Ask an Owner for an invitation, or check your suspension status with them.

teams.title: Teams
teams.lead: Each team belongs to a game and, optionally, a department. Access can be limited to single teams or departments.
teams.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Role assignments limited to this team are removed too.
teams.emptyCanCreate: Create your first team to start organizing rosters.
teams.emptyScoped: No teams are assigned to you yet.

departments.title: Departments
departments.lead: Departments group teams. Giving someone a role on a department covers all of its teams.
departments.teamCount: {count, plural, =0 {No teams} one {# team} other {# teams}}

games.title: Games
games.lead: The titles your organization competes in. Edit the list freely; deactivate a game instead of deleting it once teams use it.

members.title: Members
members.lead: Everyone in this organization and what they can access.
members.suspendLead: They are signed out immediately and can't access this organization until reactivated. Their other organizations are not affected.
members.makeOwnerConfirm: Make {name} an Owner? Owners have full control, including over other Owners.
members.editAccessLead: Each line gives one role over a scope. Their access is everything these lines allow together.

inviteForm.title: Invite someone
inviteForm.lead: They get a link to create their account and join with the access you choose here.
inviteForm.makeOwnerHint: Owners have full control of the organization.
inviteForm.emailSent: We emailed the link to {email}. You can also copy it and send it yourself.
inviteForm.emailNotSent: The email could not be sent. Copy the link and send it yourself.

scope.orgLevelNote: Organization-level permissions in this role apply organization-wide even when the role is limited to a team or department: {permissions}.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.lead: Roles are sets of permissions. Assign them to members on the whole organization, a department or a single team.
roles.nameRequired: Give the role a name in at least one language.
roles.permissionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
roles.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {Not assigned} one {Assigned once} other {Assigned # times}}
roles.lockedHint: The Owner role always has every permission and can't be edited or deleted.
roles.kindScopable: Can be limited to teams or departments
roles.ownerOnlyHint: Reserved for Owners so no one can grant themselves more access.

settings.edit: Edit organization name and default language
settings.edit_sensitive: Edit legal, tax and approval-stamp settings

members.manage: Change members' roles, suspend and reactivate

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: A permanent record of sensitive actions. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

platform.audit_viewed: Platform admin viewed the audit log

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies on every device you sign in on.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
settings.signedOutOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in} one {Signed out # other device} other {Signed out # other devices}}
settings.discordLead: Link Discord to sign in with it instead of your password.
settings.discordNotConfigured: Discord sign-in isn't set up for this platform yet.
settings.verificationNote: Contract and electronic-signature features arrive in later phases. Before relying on contracts signed in this platform for official player registration, confirm the requirements directly with the Saudi Esports Federation or your legal counsel.

platform.title: Platform admin
platform.lead: Every organization on this platform. Viewing an organization's members is recorded in its audit log.
